-- True when no value appears more than once in xs.
distinct(xs: List[int]) -> bool =
  ex distinct([1, 2, 3]) == True
  ex distinct([1, 1]) == False
  for i in range(0, xs.len())
    for j in range(i + 1, xs.len())
      if xs[i] == xs[j]
        return False
  True

-- n distinct record ids, the same on every run for the same seed.
make_ids(n: int, seed: int) -> List[int] =
  pre n >= 0
  post out.len() == n
  post distinct(out)
  ex make_ids(3, 7).len() == 3
  ex distinct(make_ids(3, 7)) == True
  -- Park-Miller minimal standard generator, modulus 2^31 - 1.
  -- Its nonzero states form one cycle of length 2^31 - 2, so n
  -- successive outputs are distinct for any n in range.
  -- Products stay below 2^47, so nothing overflows a checked int.
  let m = 2147483647
  var s = seed % m
  if s == 0
    s = 1
  var out: List[int] = []
  for i in range(0, n)
    s = (s * 48271) % m
    out.append(s)
  out

test_make_ids_distinct() =
  assert distinct(make_ids(50, 42)) == True

test_make_ids_repeatable() =
  assert make_ids(5, 9) == make_ids(5, 9)

test_make_ids_length() =
  assert make_ids(0, 1).len() == 0
  assert make_ids(7, -3).len() == 7
